items.title_zh: 欧盟2026/1788：删除两项误留紧固件税号，相关反倾销税可按海关法退还
items.title_en: EU 2026/1788 removes erroneous fastener codes and provides repayment
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1788 of 23 July 2026 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/191 imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of certain iron or steel fasteners originating in the People’s Republic of China
items.summary_zh: 条例删除7318220031和7318220095两项源于马来西亚发运反规避措施的TARIC编码：该旧措施2016年到期，但编码误留，导致自2022年无有效法律依据征税。7月25日生效、追溯自2022年2月18日适用；第2条规定相关已缴税依海关法退还。
items.summary_en: The regulation deletes TARIC 7318220031 and 7318220095, retained from an expired Malaysian-consignment measure. It applies retroactively from 18 February 2022 and provides repayment under customs law.
items.impact_zh: 原看板把这项修订解释成加强贸易限制，现予纠正。进口商应筛查相关历史报关与税单、核对退税期限；其他中国紧固件反倾销措施仍需逐项核对。
items.impact_en: Corrects the earlier restrictive interpretation. Screen historical entries and repayment deadlines; other fastener measures must be checked separately.
items.coverage: 已核对条例序言及第1—3条正文。

items.title_zh: 欧盟2026/1457：钢铁配额按国家和季度分配，现行实施期至12月31日
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1457 of 29 June 2026 on the distribution of tariff quotas opened under Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 addressing the negative trade-related effects of global overcapacity on the Union steel market
items.summary_zh: 实施条例(EU)2026/1457自7月1日至12月31日适用，落实2026/1384的26类钢材配额。普通最惠国部分与FTA部分资格不同，中国不得因转运取得FTA资格；先到先得、非优惠原产地规则适用。附件例：中国3B类非取向电工钢CN72251990/72261980年度47,351.25吨、每季11,837.81吨，配额号09.9828；表列超配额附加税50%。此数为法规分配量，非实时余额。
items.impact_zh: 输欧订单应逐项匹配CN、原产地、配额号及报关时余额，区分中国专属与剩余配额；合同约定超配额风险。12月底前跟进替代实施条例，不能把本条例自动延续到2027年。
items.summary_en: Regulation 2026/1457 applies July–December 2026 with origin-specific MFN/FTA quotas and first-come-first-served access. China's category 3B allocation is 47,351.25 tonnes annually and 11,837.81 quarterly, order 09.9828; the listed out-of-quota duty is 50%, not a live balance.
items.title_en: EU 2026/1457 distributes steel quotas by origin and quarter through 31 December
items.impact_en: Match CN, origin and order numbers to live customs balances; allocate quota risk contractually and track replacement rules before year-end.

follow_up.zh: 跟进2027年配额分配实施条例；本条例适用期截至2026-12-31。
follow_up.en: Track the successor quota-distribution act before the current act expires on 31 December.

items.coverage: 已核对正文第1–6条、附件表头和中国3B类别；未逐行核算全部类别及实时配额余额，2026/1384主条例正文遇访问验证墙。

items.title_zh: 欧盟钢铁新规正式建立18,345,922吨关税配额及50%配额外税率
items.title_original: Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 June 2026 addressing the negative trade-related effects of global overcapacity on the Union steel market and amending Regulation (EU) 2020/2170
items.summary_zh: 欧盟以（EU）2026/1384建立新的钢铁进口制度，为26类产品开放合计18,345,922吨关税配额，并规定50%的配额外附加税率；后续国别分配由实施条例具体落实。
items.impact_zh: 该法规改变中国钢材进入欧盟的基础准入成本。中国出口商应把产品类别、配额余量和既有反倾销/反补贴措施纳入同一报价与清关测算。
items.summary_en: The EU Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 establishes a new steel import system, opening a total of 18,345,922 tons of tariff quotas for 26 categories of products and stipulating a 50% additional tariff rate; subsequent country allocations will be implemented by the implementing regulation.
items.title_en: EU Establishes New Steel Import System with 18,345,922 Tons Tariff Quota and 50% Additional Tariff Rate
items.impact_en: This regulation changes the basic entry cost for Chinese steel products into the EU. Chinese exporters should incorporate product categories, quota balances, and existing anti-dumping/subsidy measures into the same quotation and customs clearance calculations.

items.title_zh: 英国10月1日钢铁新规修订：两项非合金钢丝税号移出措施范围
items.title_en: UK 1 October steel-measure amendment excludes two non-alloy wire codes
items.title_original: UK's steel trade measure from 1 July 2026
items.summary_zh: 英国官方页面10月1日更新，移除非合金钢丝税号72173049、72173090，将这两项措施税率从50%降至0%，第28类配额量不变。其余7月1日起执行的20类钢材制度总体配额较旧保障措施减少51%，超配额税率50%；旧25%保障措施于6月30日停止。第1类热轧板带还有授权用途安排，乌克兰原产货物适用单独优惠条件。
items.summary_en: The 1 October update removes wire codes 72173049 and 72173090, reducing their measure rate from 50% to 0% without changing category 28 quotas. The July regime otherwise reduces overall quotas by 51% with a 50% out-of-quota tariff across 20 categories. Category 1 has authorised-use arrangements; Ukraine has separate origin-conditioned preferences.
items.impact_zh: 钢丝出口商应立即核对归类与新报价；移出本措施不等于免除所有其他关税或贸易救济。其他钢材订单须核对配额、原产地和授权用途，尤其热轧第1类，不能直接套用旧25%费率。本研判仅适用10月1日版本，旧7月2日记录不套用新版结论。
items.impact_en: Wire exporters should check classification and quotations immediately. Exclusion does not remove other applicable duties. Other shipments require quota, origin and authorised-use checks. This brief applies only to the 1 October revision.

items.title_zh: 欧盟钢铁新规运行情况咨询：10 月 11 日截止，出口商可参与
items.title_en: EU steel regulation monitoring consultation closes 11 October
items.title_original: Monitoring the functioning of the new EU Steel Regulation
items.summary_zh: 欧委会 9 月 28 日启动对条例 (EU) 2026/1384 运行情况的定向咨询，面向上游钢企、下游用户、协会、第三国政府与出口商等。截止为 2026 年 10 月 11 日 23:59（CEST）；不同产品类别可分别提交回复。
items.summary_en: The Commission opened a targeted consultation on Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 on 28 September for producers, users, associations, third-country governments and exporters. Deadline: 11 October 2026, 23:59 CEST; separate responses may cover different product categories.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：尽快协调客户用实际配额、供货及成本影响提交意见，保留提交记录；咨询启动不代表配额或税率已调整。
items.impact_en: Assessment: coordinate customer evidence on quotas, supply and costs and retain submission records. Opening the consultation does not change quotas or duty rates.
items.source_excerpt: A targeted consultation seeking stakeholders' feedback on the implementation of the new EU Steel Regulation Steel producers (upstream), steel users (downstream), business associations, third country governments and exporters, and any other interested stakeholders. follow_up.action_zh: 在德国时间 10 月 11 日 23:59 前提交反馈，协调并记录客户参与情况
follow_up.action_en: Submit before 11 October 23:59 CEST and track customer participation.

items.title_zh: 欧盟对取向电工钢实施临时保障措施，涉及配额与价格门槛
items.title_en: EU imposes provisional GOES safeguards with quotas and price thresholds
items.title_original: Commission imposes provisional safeguard measures on imports of grain-oriented electrical steel
items.summary_zh: 欧委会于 9 月 18 日宣布对进口取向电工钢采取临时保障措施，形式为关税配额结合价格门槛。范围包括加工后的叠片和铁芯，以及已装入变压器的铁芯。
items.summary_en: On 18 September the Commission announced provisional safeguards on grain-oriented electrical steel, using tariff-rate quotas and price thresholds. The scope includes laminations, cores and cores incorporated in transformers.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：出口取向电工钢及相关下游产品需核对正式法规中的产品范围、配额与价格条件；该公告不是最终保障措施。
items.impact_en: Monitoring assessment: exporters should check the legal product scope, quotas and price conditions. These are provisional measures.
items.source_excerpt: News article 18 September 2026 Commission imposes provisional safeguard measures on imports of grain-oriented electrical steel Today, the European Commission imposed provisional safeguard measures on imports of grain-oriented electrical steel products, in the form of tariff-rate quotas coupled with price thresholds. 2 min read

items.title_zh: 英国：对中国及俄罗斯部分冷轧板的旧反倾销措施于8月5日到期
items.title_en: UK: historical cold-rolled steel anti-dumping measure expired on 5 August
items.title_original: Trade remedies notices: anti-dumping duty on cold-rolled iron and steel products from China and Russia (expired)
items.summary_zh: 英国官方集合页及2022/04公告明确：部分冷轧平板反倾销税于2026年8月5日到期，2022/04公告不再适用。历史范围为未镀覆、加工不超过冷轧的非不锈钢平板，并排除部分电工钢、黑板及高速钢；旧税率表是历史信息。
items.summary_en: The official collection and notice 2022/04 expressly state that the cold-rolled measure expired on 5 August 2026 and no longer applies. The historical product scope excludes specified electrical steel, black plate and high-speed steel; old duty tables are historical.
items.impact_zh: 英国冷轧业务应更新报价税负底表，勿继续套用旧22.1%余项税率。仍需核对当前英国税则、配额措施及任何后续新措施；不能据此判断欧盟反倾销税到期。
items.impact_en: Update UK cold-rolled costing and stop treating the historical 22.1% residual rate as current. Check current UK tariffs and quotas; this does not imply EU duties have expired.

machine_translation.title_zh: 贸易补救通知:中国和俄罗斯关于冷轧钢铁产品的反倾销税(过期)

items.coverage: 已核对集合页到期更新及2022/04公告正文；未将历史税率作现行税率。

items.title_zh: 欧盟启动中国与台湾冷轧不锈钢板卷反倾销到期复审
items.title_en: EU opens expiry review of Chinese and Taiwanese cold-rolled stainless steel
items.title_original: Notice of initiation of an expiry review of the anti-dumping measures applicable to imports of cold rolled stainless steel sheets and coils originating in the People’s Republic of China and Taiwan
items.summary_zh: 欧盟公报 C/2026/4830 启动冷轧不锈钢板卷到期复审，涉及 CN 7219、7220 下列明子目。复审调查期为 2025 年 7 月 1 日至 2026 年 6 月 30 日；针对立案的意见原则上须在 9 月 15 日公布后 37 天内提交。
items.summary_en: Notice C/2026/4830 opens an expiry review of cold-rolled stainless flat products under listed CN 7219/7220 subheadings. Review period: 1 July 2025–30 June 2026. Comments on initiation are generally due within 37 days of publication on 15 September.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：这不是撤税或新税率公告。涉及不锈钢出口的企业应让应诉团队确认适用范围、抽样与已过/尚未到期的不同提交期限。
items.impact_en: Assessment: this is not a duty-removal or new-rate notice. Counsel should distinguish scope, sampling and separate submission deadlines.

follow_up.action_zh: 核对立案意见 37 天期限及应诉文件实际到期日
follow_up.action_en: Check the 37-day initiation-comment deadline and case-specific filing dates.

items.title_zh: 欧盟对中国和土耳其焊接钢丝网进口实施登记
items.title_en: EU requires registration of welded steel mesh imports from China and Türkiye
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2022 of 10 September 2026 making imports of welded steel mesh originating in the People’s Republic of China and Türkiye subject to registration with a view to allowing the levy of anti-dumping duties on the imports subject to registration
items.summary_zh: 欧盟实施条例(EU) 2026/2022自2026年9月12日起生效，要求海关登记原产于中国和土耳其的交点焊接普通钢丝格栅、网片、网和围栏，不论是否镀锌、涂层或卷装，现列CN 7314 20 90、7314 31 00和7314 39 00。登记为期9个月，目的是在法定条件满足时允许追溯征收反倾销税。
items.summary_en: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2022 took effect on 12 September 2026 and directs customs authorities to register welded-at-intersection grill, mesh, netting and fencing of plain wire from China and Türkiye, whether plated, coated, galvanised or in rolls, currently under CN 7314 20 90, 7314 31 00 and 7314 39 00. Registration lasts nine months and may support retroactive duties if the legal conditions are met.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：登记不是反倾销终裁，也未确定实际税率。投诉材料中的中国倾销幅度26%至73%、损害消除水平18%仅供现阶段参考。涉欧订单应自9月12日起单列登记进口、保存产品规格和报关记录，并在报价中保留追溯征税条款。
items.impact_en: Assessment: registration is not a final anti-dumping determination and sets no actual duty rate. Complaint estimates of 26–73% dumping and an 18% injury-elimination level for China are informational only. Segregate registered EU entries from 12 September, preserve specifications and customs records, and address retroactive-duty risk in contracts.
items.follow_up: 跟踪反倾销调查临时/终裁及是否追溯征税；现行登记期最长至2027-06-12。
items.coverage: Official EUR-Lex full text checked, including product scope, CN codes, registration purpose and nine-month duration.

items.title_zh: 欧盟对中国钢制货架及部件进口实施登记
items.title_en: EU requires registration of Chinese steel shelving units and components
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2023 of 10 September 2026 making imports of bolted and boltless steel shelves originating in the People’s Republic of China subject to registration with a view to allowing the levy of anti-dumping duties on the imports subject to registration
items.summary_zh: 欧盟实施条例(EU) 2026/2023自2026年9月12日起生效，要求登记中国原产的螺栓式和无螺栓钢制货架及部件，包括具有两个平面连接面的钢立柱、无焊接立柱连接件的钢横梁，以及包含上述部件的货架（可有或无任何材质层板）。现列CN ex 9403 20 80、ex 9403 99 10，TARIC 9403 20 80 20、9403 99 10 20；登记为期9个月。
items.summary_en: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2023 took effect on 12 September 2026 and requires registration of Chinese bolted and boltless steel shelving units and components, including steel uprights with two flat connecting surfaces, steel beams without welded upright connectors and shelving containing those components, with or without decks of any material. Current codes are CN ex 9403 20 80 and ex 9403 99 10, TARIC 9403 20 80 20 and 9403 99 10 20; registration lasts nine months.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：登记不等于已征税，投诉中的62%至103%倾销幅度和290%至310%损害消除水平不是最终税率。中国货架供应商及欧盟进口商应从9月12日起筛查对应TARIC条目，留存产品结构、连接方式和进口记录，并在合同中安排可能追溯征税的承担机制。
items.impact_en: Assessment: registration does not itself impose a duty. Complaint estimates of 62–103% dumping and 290–310% injury elimination are not final rates. Chinese suppliers and EU importers should screen the listed TARIC entries from 12 September, retain product-structure and import records, and allocate potential retroactive-duty risk contractually.
items.follow_up: 跟踪反倾销调查临时/终裁及是否追溯征税；现行登记期最长至2027-06-12。
items.coverage: Official EUR-Lex full text checked, including scope wording, CN/TARIC codes, registration purpose and duration.

items.title_zh: 欧盟对华硅锰焊丝临时反倾销：税率 75.3%—102.4%
items.title_en: EU provisional AD on Chinese silico-manganese welding wire: 75.3%–102.4%
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1929 of 7 August 2026 imposing a provisional anti-dumping duty on imports of certain wires of silico-manganese steel originating in the People’s Republic of China
items.summary_zh: 条例 (EU) 2026/1929 于 8 月 10 日公布、次日生效，针对符合成分及直径条件的硅锰钢丝，TARIC 7229200010。常州运河 75.3%，Juli 集团 102.4%，其他合作企业 93.1%，其他中国进口 102.4%；个别税率需符合规定的商业发票。
items.summary_en: Regulation (EU) 2026/1929, published 10 August and effective the next day, imposes provisional duties on specified silico-manganese wire (TARIC 7229200010): Yunhe 75.3%, Juli 102.4%, other cooperating firms 93.1%, all other Chinese imports 102.4%. Individual rates require a compliant invoice.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：仅对该产品条件适用，不能外推到普通线材；放行需相当于临时税额的担保，后续终裁可能调整。
items.impact_en: Assessment: apply only to the defined wire, not all wire rod. Release requires security equivalent to the provisional duty; definitive findings may change.

items.title_zh: 欧盟2026/1785：浙江Yitai获紧固件新出口生产商待遇，税率39.6%
items.title_en: EU 2026/1785: Zhejiang Yitai receives new-exporter treatment at 39.6%
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1785 of 23 July 2026 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/191 imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of certain iron or steel fasteners originating in the People’s Republic of China following acceptance of a request for new exporting producer treatment
items.summary_zh: 7月24日公布的实施条例(EU)2026/1785将Zhejiang Yitai Mechanical Technology Co., Ltd列入2022/191未抽样合作企业名单，TARIC附加代码88ES，反倾销税率39.6%，公布翌日生效。申请满足原调查期2019年7月1日至2020年6月30日未对欧出口、无相关受措施企业关联、调查期后实际出口三项条件；不是取消中国紧固件整体反倾销税。
items.summary_en: Published 24 July and effective the next day, Regulation 2026/1785 adds Zhejiang Yitai to the non-sampled cooperating fastener producers at 39.6%, TARIC code 88ES. It is company-specific new-exporter treatment.
items.impact_zh: 该企业及进口商应核对英文法人名称、88ES与商业发票要求。其他新出口企业可评估资格证据，但不得套用他人附加代码或39.6%税率。
items.impact_en: Match the legal producer identity, 88ES and invoice requirements; other exporters cannot use this company's code or rate.
items.coverage: 已核对2026/1785条例正文；完整产品范围及发票条件仍按其引用的2022/191及后续修订核对。

items.title_zh: 案件C-889/24，DELVE 2：2026年5月21日法院（第二庭）判决（拉脱维亚行政区法院的初步裁决请求）
items.title_en: Case C-889/24, Delve 2: Judgment of the Court (Second Chamber) of 21 May 2026 (request for a preliminary ruling from the Administratīvā rajona tiesa – Latvia)
items.title_original: Case C-889/24, Delve 2: Judgment of the Court (Second Chamber) of 21 May 2026 (request for a preliminary ruling from the Administratīvā rajona tiesa – Latvia) – DELVE 2 SIA v Valsts ieņēmumu dienests (Reference for a preliminary ruling – Customs union – Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/191 – Imposition of a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of certain iron or steel fasteners originating in the People’s Republic of China – Article 1(3) – Customs declaration – Application for amendment – Presentation by the importer, after making the customs declaration, of a commercial invoice meeting the requirements of that provision)
items.summary_zh: 该判决涉及对来自中国的某些铁或钢紧固件的最终反倾销税的实施，涉及海关申报和商业发票的要求。
items.summary_en: This judgment concerns the implementation of the definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of certain iron or steel fasteners from China, addressing customs declaration and commercial invoice requirements.
items.impact_zh: 此判决可能影响中国出口商的海关申报流程，增加合规成本。
items.impact_en: This judgment may affect the customs declaration processes for Chinese exporters, increasing compliance costs.

items.title_zh: 美国：更正中国拉制不锈钢水槽日落复审余项补贴率为8.51%
items.title_en: US corrects Chinese drawn stainless-steel sink sunset-review rate to 8.51%
items.title_original: Drawn Stainless Steel Sinks From the People's Republic of China: Final Results of the Expedited First and Second Sunset Reviews of the Countervailing Duty Order; Correction
items.summary_zh: 10月6日公告2026-20481纠正2018和2023两次反补贴日落复审终裁中的错误：其他企业补贴率原写8.61%，应为8.51%。这是历史公告数字更正，不是对所有中国钢材新增税率。
items.summary_en: Notice 2026-20481 corrects the all-others subsidy rate in the 2018 and 2023 sunset results from 8.61% to 8.51%. It is a correction of historical notices.
items.impact_zh: 水槽出口及美国进口商应更新案件档案，由律师核对现行保证金、清算指令及历史记录，不能直接把8.51%当所有企业当前税率。
items.impact_en: Update case records and have counsel check current deposits and liquidation instructions. Do not apply 8.51% indiscriminately.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) published notice in the Federal Register of July 25, 2018 and October 20, 2023 in which Commerce announced the final results of the first and second sunset reviews of the countervailing duty (CVD) order on drawn stainless steel sinks from the People's Republic of China (China). These notices incorrectly stated an all-others rate of 8.61 percent.
items.coverage: 已核对Federal Register正文及公开审阅PDF；未核对各企业当前CBP保证金指令。

items.title_zh: 美国对华定尺碳钢板第五次日落复审终裁：撤令可能导致倾销延续
items.title_en: US fifth sunset review finds dumping likely to recur for Chinese cut-to-length carbon steel plate
items.title_original: Certain Cut-to-Length Carbon Steel Plate From the People's Republic of China and the Russian Federation: Final Results of the Expedited Fifth Sunset Reviews of the Antidumping Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部第五次快速日落复审终裁（A-570-849；91 FR 63265）认定，撤销对中国和俄罗斯定尺碳钢板反倾销令可能导致倾销继续或再现；可能继续或再现的加权平均倾销幅度最高为中国128.59%、俄罗斯185.00%。由于没有被调查方提交实质答复，商务部采用120天快速复审程序；结果自2026年10月5日起适用。
items.summary_en: Commerce's expedited fifth sunset-review results (A-570-849; 91 FR 63265) find that revoking the China and Russia CTL-plate AD orders would likely lead to continuation or recurrence of dumping. Margins likely to prevail are up to 128.59% for China and 185.00% for Russia. No respondent interested party filed a substantive response, so Commerce used the 120-day expedited procedure. The results apply from 5 October 2026.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：128.59%是日落复审中的“可能继续或再现”幅度，不是所有中国出口商自本公告起统一适用的新现金保证金率。本公告支持维持现有反倾销令，但仍应跟踪USITC损害复审及后续续令公告；涉美定尺板业务应继续按企业适用税率报价，不应假设措施即将撤销。
items.impact_en: Assessment: 128.59% is the sunset-review margin likely to prevail, not a new uniform cash-deposit rate for every Chinese exporter. The finding supports continuation of the order, subject to the injury-side review and subsequent continuation notice. US CTL-plate business should keep using company-specific applicable rates and not assume the order will lapse.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) finds that revocation of the antidumping duty (AD) orders on certain cut-to-length carbon steel plate (CTL plate) from the People's Republic of China (China) and the Russian Federation (Russia) would be likely to lead to continuation or recurrence of dumping, at the levels indicated in the "Final Results of Sunset Reviews" section of this notice.
items.coverage: Official Federal Register full notice reviewed, including final-results margins; the linked Issues and Decision Memorandum was not treated as separately reviewed.

items.title_zh: 欧盟公布2026年第三季度CBAM证书价格：82.32欧元
items.title_en: EU publishes Q3 2026 CBAM certificate price of €82.32
items.title_original: Q3 2026 CBAM Certificate price now available!
items.summary_zh: 欧委会10月5日公布2026年第三季度CBAM证书价格为每张82.32欧元；第二季度为75.28欧元，环比上升约9.4%。季度价格按欧盟碳排放配额拍卖成交价加权平均计算，适用于对应季度进口CBAM商品的隐含排放；2026年证书从2027年2月起在统一中央平台购买。
items.summary_en: On 5 October the Commission published the Q3 2026 CBAM certificate price at €82.32, about 9.4% above Q2's €75.28. The quarterly price is the weighted average of EU ETS auction clearing prices and applies to embedded emissions in CBAM goods imported during the relevant quarter; 2026 certificates become purchasable on the common central platform from February 2027.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：钢铁出口商应把82.32欧元作为第三季度对应证书的官方价格输入，与欧盟进口商更新碳成本测算和合同调价假设；它不是钢材吨税，也不能脱离经核验的产品隐含排放、免费分配调整和已支付碳价直接换算应缴额。
items.impact_en: Assessment: use €82.32 as the official certificate-price input for Q3 and update carbon-cost and contract assumptions with EU importers. It is not a per-tonne steel tariff and cannot determine liability without verified embedded emissions, free-allocation adjustment and eligible carbon prices already paid.
items.source_excerpt: 05 Oct 2026 Q3 2026 CBAM Certificate price now available! Each 2026 quarterly price is calculated by the Commission in the first calendar week after the quarter ends, based on publicly available EU ETS auction information.
items.coverage: Official DG TAXUD price table and methodology page checked on 5 October 2026.

items.title_zh: 美国更正对华对焊管件公告：明确追溯暂停清算和现金保证金
items.title_en: US Commerce correction clarifies retroactive suspension for China-origin butt-weld pipe fittings processed in Vietnam
items.title_original: Certain Carbon Steel Butt-Weld Pipe Fittings From the People's Republic of China: Notice of Court Decision Not in Harmony With Final Covered Merchandise Determination and Notice of Amended Covered Merchandise Determination Pursuant to Court Decision; Correction
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部10月2日发布更正（A-570-814；91 FR 62700），补入8月28日公告遗漏的追溯执行段落。对在中国形成粗坯、在越南完成第二或第三阶段加工且物理特征相同的相关产品：已暂停的条目继续暂停并适用相应现金保证金；尚未暂停且未清算的条目，2022年9月26日及以后进口的须暂停清算并缴纳保证金；2021年11月4日之后、2022年9月26日之前进口且仍未清算的条目亦同。该认定按同一国家的出口商或进口商层面适用。
items.summary_en: Commerce's 2 October correction (A-570-814; 91 FR 62700) adds omitted retroactive implementation language to the 28 August notice. For China-formed rough shapes completed through second or third production stages in Vietnam and sharing the relevant physical characteristics, CBP is to continue existing suspensions and apply cash deposits; suspend still-unliquidated entries on or after 26 September 2022; and also suspend still-unliquidated entries after 4 November 2021 but before 26 September 2022, at the applicable rate. The finding applies on a country-wide exporter or importer basis.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：更正没有公布统一新税率，但显著扩大了需要追溯核对的未清算条目范围。相关出口商、越南加工商和美国进口商应立即按两个日期区间筛查历史未清算进口，核对保证金及海关指令，并保存粗坯物理特征、加工和原产链证据。
items.impact_en: Assessment: the correction sets no uniform new rate but materially clarifies the historical unliquidated entries subject to suspension. Exporters, Vietnamese processors and US importers should screen entries against both date windows, verify cash-deposit and CBP instructions, and preserve evidence on rough-shape characteristics, processing and origin.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) published notice to the public in the Federal Register of August 28, 2026 that the U.S. Court of International Trade's (CIT) final judgment was not in harmony with Commerce's covered merchandise inquiry (CMI) determination. Specifically, Commerce amended the CMI determination to find that products cut to length and formed into the rough shape of certain carbon steel butt-weld pipe fittings (butt-weld pipe fittings) in the People's Republic of China (China) represent "unfinished" fittings, which are covered by the scope of the Order, and that when such products are further processed in the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (Vietnam), they remain subject to the antidumping (AD) order on butt- weld pipe fittings from China. This notice did not provide clear notice to parties that the liquidation of entries of these unfinished fittings will be retroactively suspended.
items.coverage: Official Federal Register correction and the linked 28 August notice checked; date windows are limited to still-unliquidated covered entries.

items.title_zh: 英国钢铁措施缩小范围：两项非合金钢丝编码税率降为 0%
items.title_en: UK steel measure removes two non-alloy wire codes from 1 October
items.title_original: UK's steel trade measure from 1 July 2026
items.summary_zh: 英国政府10月1日更新钢铁贸易措施，将非合金钢丝商品编码72173049和72173090移出适用范围，对应税率由50%降为0%；Category 28配额量保持不变。其他纳入范围的产品配额外税率仍为50%。
items.summary_en: The UK updated its steel trade measure on 1 October, removing non-alloy wire codes 72173049 and 72173090. Their tariff falls from 50% to 0%; Category 28 quota volumes are unchanged. The 50% out-of-quota tariff remains for other covered products.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：涉及上述两个编码的在途和新订单应立即复核英国报关税率及商品归类；该变化不适用于Category 28其他钢丝编码，也没有增加剩余配额。
items.impact_en: Assessment: recheck UK classification and entry treatment for shipments under these two codes. The change does not cover other Category 28 wire codes or increase the remaining quota.
items.source_excerpt: Details about a new steel trade measure from 1 July 2026, which limits tariff-free steel import quota volumes. On 19 March 2026, the government announced a new steel trade measure , taking effect from 1 July 2026. This measure has been implemented using powers in the Taxation (Cross Border Trade) Act 2018 , as amended. The government has carried out a programme of intensive industry engagement since the announcement. We have also engaged closely with the European Union ( EU ) ahead of their new steel trade measure coming into effect and agreed an approach that reflects the UK and EU ’s highly interconnected supply chains. From 1 July 2026, the government is limiting tariff-free steel imports, reducing overall quota volumes by 51% compared with the steel safeguard measure. Any imports above these levels will face a 50% tariff. The measure applies to imports of steel products that can also be made in the UK. The steel safeguard quotas and the 25% additional safeguard duty ceased to appl…
items.coverage: Official GOV.UK collection update history and current measure page reviewed.

items.title_en: US opens administrative reviews covering Chinese steel nails, brake drums and metal lockers
items.title_original: Initiation of Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Administrative Reviews
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部10月1日启动8月周年月的反倾销/反补贴行政复审。其中对华涉钢项目包括钢钉A-570-909（复审期2025年8月1日至2026年7月31日）、制动鼓A-570-174/C-570-175及金属储物柜A-570-133/C-570-134。公告预计最终结果不晚于2027年8月31日。

China-related steel cases include steel nails A-570-909 (POR 1 August 2025–31 July 2026), brake drums A-570-174/C-570-175 and metal lockers A-570-133/C-570-134. Final results are intended by 31 August 2027.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：被列名企业应让美国律师立即核对独立税率申请或证明、Q&V问卷及APO等个案期限；独立税率材料原则上须在公告后14个日历日内提交。此次是复审立案，不是新税率终裁。
items.impact_en: Assessment: listed firms should have US counsel check separate-rate applications/certifications, Q&V questionnaires and APO deadlines immediately. Separate-rate filings are generally due within 14 calendar days of publication. This is review initiation, not a new final rate.

items.title_zh: CBAM 证书操作说明：2026 年排放于 2027 年购证清缴
items.title_en: CBAM certificate factsheet: 2026 emissions settled in 2027
items.summary_zh: 9 月 30 日发布的说明：证书拟于 2027 年 2 月 1 日开售；2026 年无季度持证义务，相关证书须于 2027 年 9 月 30 日前购买并清缴。此后季度末持证覆盖至少 50% 的年内累计隐含排放；最终数量按适用规则调整。
items.summary_en: The 30 September factsheet schedules sales for 1 February 2027. No quarterly holding obligation applies in 2026; certificates for that year's emissions must be purchased and surrendered by 30 September 2027. Subsequent quarter-end holdings cover at least 50% of year-to-date embedded emissions, subject to applicable adjustments.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：与进口商分别安排 2026 年排放资料和 2027 年资金；购证延后不代表 2026 年进口免除碳成本。
items.impact_en: Assessment: separate 2026 emissions documentation from 2027 funding. Deferred certificate purchases do not exempt 2026 imports from carbon costs.
items.source_excerpt: How CBAM certificates work Starting in 2027, CBAM importers must submit their annual CBAM declaration by 30 September for imports of CBAM goods during the preceding year. The CBAM declaration reports the quantity of goods imported, their embedded emissions, and the corresponding number of certificates. General publications 30 September 2026 English Download (2.97 MB - PDF)
items.coverage: Official two-page factsheet reviewed; explanatory guidance, not a new regulation.

items.title_zh: GFSEC 通过密尔沃基框架：加强贸易救济、反规避与熔炼浇铸地透明度
items.title_en: GFSEC Milwaukee Framework: trade remedies, anti-circumvention and melt-and-pour transparency
items.title_original: Ambassador Greer Issues Statement Following the Ministerial Meeting of the Global Forum on Steel Excess Capacity
items.summary_zh: USTR 9 月 30 日确认 GFSEC 部长会议通过联合行动框架。正式文件提出在各自法律框架下减少扭曲市场的支持、强化熔炼浇铸地数据、开展反倾销/反补贴/保障措施调查并协调反规避；各成员实施力度可因国内情况不同。
items.summary_en: USTR confirmed agreement on 30 September. The framework calls for reducing distortive support, improving melt-and-pour data, trade-remedy investigations and coordinated anti-circumvention, within national legal frameworks; implementation may differ by member.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：中国钢材及含钢下游产品的多市场贸易救济与溯源风险上升。准备真实熔炼浇铸地、生产商及加工链证明，关注各国后续公告；框架本身没有设定统一新增税率，也不是 G20 全体已一致加税。
items.impact_en: Assessment: monitor trade-remedy and traceability risks across markets. Prepare melt-and-pour and processing-chain evidence and check subsequent national measures. The framework itself sets no uniform new tariff and is not a unanimous G20 tariff decision.

items.coverage: USTR release and final GFSEC framework/ministerial statement checked.

items.title_en: US Chinese boltless shelving review: injury likely to continue or recur if duties revoked
items.title_original: Boltless Steel Shelving Units Prepackaged for Sale From China; Determinations
items.summary_zh: USITC 于 9 月 29 日公布第二次日落复审裁定，案号 701-TA-523、731-TA-1259：撤销对华预包装无螺栓钢货架反倾销、反补贴令，可能导致美国行业实质损害延续或再现。裁定于 9 月 24 日完成。
items.summary_en: The 29 September notice publishes USITC's second sunset-review determination in cases 701-TA-523 and 731-TA-1259: revoking the Chinese boltless shelving AD/CVD orders would likely lead to continuing or recurring material injury. The determination was completed on 24 September.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：不能按即将撤税报价；具体税率与商务部续令须另查。本裁定针对预包装货架，不等同于对所有钢材新增双反税。
items.impact_en: Assessment: do not price on an assumed duty removal; check Commerce's continuation notice and applicable rates. The determination concerns prepackaged shelving.

items.summary_zh: USITC 公告安排中国、台湾和土耳其镀锡板等产品调查最终阶段，案号 701-TA-792、731-TA-1786-1788；范围包括镀锡及镀铬/氧化铬薄板。听证 12 月 4 日，听证申请 11 月 25 日前、庭前陈述 11 月 27 日前、庭后书面意见 12 月 11 日前；书面产品描述优先于 HTSUS 编码。

items.impact_en: Assessment: coordinate scope and participation deadlines with counsel for US tinplate/TFS business. This is a procedural schedule, not a final duty rate.

items.source_excerpt: The Commission hereby gives notice of the scheduling of the final phase of antidumping and countervailing duty investigation Nos. 701-TA-792 and 731-TA-1786-1788 (Final) pursuant to the Tariff Act of 1930 to determine whether an industry in the United States is materially injured or threatened with material injury, or the establishment of an industry in the United States is materially retarded, by reason of imports of tin mill products from China, Taiwan, and Turkey, provided for in subheadings 7210.11.00, 7210.12.00, 7210.50.00, 7212.10.00, 7212.50.00, if of non-alloy steel and under HTSUS subheadings 7225.99.00, and 7226.99.01 of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States, preliminarily determined by the Department of Commerce ("Commerce") to be subsidized and sold at less-than-fair-value. items.title_en: US preliminarily finds Cambodian-assembled steel wire hangers circumvent China and Vietnam orders
items.title_original: Steel Wire Garment Hangers From the People's Republic of China and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam: Preliminary Affirmative Determination of Circumvention of the Antidumping Duty Order on Steel Wire Garment Hangers From the People's Republic of China and the Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Orders on Steel Wire Garment Hangers From the Socialist Republic of Vietnam
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部初步认定（A-570-918、A-552-812、C-552-813；91 FR 60086），在柬埔寨使用中国或越南产钢丝，或钢丝及纸配件完成并出口美国的钢丝衣架，在全国范围构成规避。2025年8月12日及以后进入美国且尚未清算的相关条目须暂停清算并缴纳保证金。未能按双重认证计划证明使用中国原料的，公告拟按越南全国反倾销率220.68%及反补贴其他企业率31.58%处理；证明使用中国原料的按对华衣架反倾销令适用税率处理。
items.summary_en: Commerce preliminarily finds (A-570-918/A-552-812/C-552-813; 91 FR 60086) that hangers completed in Cambodia from Chinese- or Vietnamese-origin steel wire, or steel wire and paper accessories, circumvent the respective orders on a country-wide basis. Relevant unliquidated entries on or after 12 August 2025 are suspended. Entries not certified under the dual program as using Chinese inputs are intended to face the Vietnam-wide AD rate of 220.68% plus the CVD all-others rate of 31.58%; certified Chinese-input entries use the applicable China hanger AD rate.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：这是初裁，但已产生追溯暂停清算、保证金和认证义务。中国钢丝经柬埔寨组装的供应链应核对原料原产、生产记录、ACE/DIS申报和第三国案号；历史未清算条目的认证及证明材料原则上最迟须在11月6日前完成，听证申请原则上10月22日前提交。Alpha Hanger、Everbrit和Kaining在本初裁下不能使用该认证。
items.impact_en: Assessment: although preliminary, the finding already creates retroactive suspension, cash-deposit and certification obligations. China-to-Cambodia supply chains should verify input origin, production records, ACE/DIS filings and third-country case numbers. Certifications for historical unliquidated entries are generally due by 6 November; hearing requests are generally due 22 October. Alpha Hanger, Everbrit and Kaining are ineligible for the certification under this preliminary finding.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that imports of steel wire garment hangers (hangers), completed in Cambodia using: (1) steel wire or (2) steel wire and paper accessories, produced in the People's Republic of China (China) or the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (Vietnam), are circumventing the antidumping duty (AD) order on hangers from China, or the AD and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on hangers from Vietnam. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.

items.title_en: US preliminarily finds Chinese CGI brake drums circumvent AD/CVD orders
items.title_original: Certain Brake Drums From the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Affirmative Determination of Circumvention of the Antidumping Duty and Countervailing Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部初步认定（A-570-174、C-570-175；91 FR 60082），中国制致密石墨铸铁（CGI）制动鼓属于后续发展商品，在全国范围规避对华制动鼓反倾销和反补贴令。调查产品内径14.75英寸至16.6英寸、重量超过50磅，包括公告所举M328D557型号。2026年1月27日及以后进入美国且尚未清算的条目将暂停清算；一般情况下按中国全国反倾销率150.25%和反补贴“其他企业”率11.94%收取保证金，已有企业单独税率的按其适用税率。
items.summary_en: Commerce preliminarily finds (A-570-174/C-570-175; 91 FR 60082) that Chinese compacted graphite iron brake drums are later-developed merchandise circumventing the China brake-drum AD/CVD orders on a country-wide basis. Covered inquiry merchandise has an inside diameter of 14.75–16.6 inches and weighs more than 50 pounds, including model M328D557. Unliquidated entries on or after 27 January 2026 are to be suspended; generally the China-wide AD rate is 150.25% and the CVD all-others rate 11.94%, while company-specific rates apply where available.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：这是规避调查初裁，不是最终结论，但已触发暂停清算和保证金要求。相关制造商、出口商和美国进口商应立即核对材质、尺寸、重量、型号及历史未清算条目；评论原则上于10月6日前、听证申请于10月22日前通过ACCESS提交，具体期限应由美国律师确认。
items.impact_en: Assessment: this is a preliminary circumvention finding, not a final determination, but suspension and cash-deposit requirements already apply. Producers, exporters and US importers should review material, dimensions, weight, model numbers and historical unliquidated entries. Comments are generally due 6 October and hearing requests 22 October; US counsel should confirm the filing dates.

items.title_original: Certain Carbon Steel Butt-Weld Pipe Fittings From the People's Republic of China: Notice of Court Decision Not in Harmony With Final Covered Merchandise Determination and Notice of Amended Covered Merchandise Determination Pursuant to Court Decision
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部公告（A-570-814；91 FR 55518）落实美国国际贸易法院2026年7月29日判决，自2026年8月8日起修正覆盖商品认定：中国境内切割并形成对焊管件粗坯的产品属于反倾销令范围内的“未制成品”；随后在越南完成第二、第三阶段加工，仍受对华碳钢对焊管件反倾销令约束。商务部将要求海关暂停相关成品和未制成品清算并按适用税率收取现金保证金。
items.summary_en: Commerce's notice (A-570-814; 91 FR 55518) implements the CIT's 29 July 2026 judgment and applies from 8 August 2026. Rough shapes cut to length and formed in China are unfinished butt-weld pipe fittings within the order; subsequent second- or third-stage processing in Vietnam does not remove them from the China AD order. CBP is to suspend liquidation and collect cash deposits at the applicable rate.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：这是法院判决后的覆盖范围修正，不是新立案或统一新税率。中国粗坯经越南后加工的供应链应立即核对报关、原产地和现金保证金安排，保存中国成形及越南加工阶段记录，并由美国律师确认具体条目适用税率与诉讼进展。
items.impact_en: Assessment: this is a court-driven scope amendment, not a new investigation or a uniform new duty rate. China-to-Vietnam processing chains should review entries, origin evidence and cash-deposit treatment, retain records for each processing stage, and have US counsel confirm the entry-specific rate and litigation status.

items.summary_zh: A-570-104终裁覆盖2024年4月1日至2025年3月31日。宁波定拓/宁波金鼎作为单一实体、宁波东信及浙江君悦均为0.74%；未获单独税率的中国全国实体维持48.91%。自2026年7月17日公布起，所列企业保证金为0.74%，其他已获单独税率企业延续各自既有税率；历史进口清算按进口商特定核定税率办理。
items.impact_zh: 这是终裁，不是所有中国螺纹杆统一降税。出口商与进口商应核对企业英文名称、案号及报关对应关系，分别确认新保证金与历史清算；报价还须核对其他适用税费。

items.title_en: US threaded rod final review: 0.74% for reviewed separate-rate exporters
items.impact_en: Match exporter identities, case numbers and entries. Distinguish future deposits from historical assessment and verify other applicable duties.

items.title_zh: 英国CBAM注册路线：2027年起适用，门槛为进口金额£50,000
items.title_en: UK CBAM registration roadmap: £50,000 threshold from 2027
items.title_original: Check if you’ll need to register for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
items.summary_zh: HMRC注册集合页说明，2027年1月1日起进口指定铝、水泥、化肥、氢、钢铁产品须评估责任。依次核对税号、责任进口人、门槛排除情形和注册起算日；货值超过或预计超过£50,000须按规则注册。注册服务最迟2028年1月1日开放，此前已产生责任仍须保存记录。
items.summary_en: From 1 January 2027, importers of specified goods must assess liability using commodity codes, importer status, exclusions and registration timing. The value threshold is £50,000. Registration opens by 1 January 2028; earlier liability still requires records.
items.impact_zh: 提前与英国客户确认责任主体、年度采购计划和记录交付；不要将注册平台开放时间误当税制开始时间，也不要混用欧盟50吨门槛。
items.impact_en: Agree importer responsibilities and evidence delivery now. Platform opening is not the start of liability, and the EU's 50-tonne threshold is different.
items.coverage: 已核对官方正文；仅总结本页，不表示已阅读全文所链接的法规或附件。

items.title_zh: 英国CBAM：私人用途、退运及特殊海关程序如何影响注册门槛
items.title_en: UK CBAM: exclusions and special procedures for the registration threshold
items.title_original: Imported Carbon Border Adjustment (CBAM) goods that may not contribute towards the registration threshold
items.summary_zh: HMRC指南列明私人用途、英国原产、符合退运减免及全额关税减免临时进口等排除情形。特殊程序货物释放为英国自由流通且应缴关税时可计入门槛；进境加工成CBAM货物计全值，加工成非CBAM货物仍计原CBAM部分价值，境外加工回运按规定价值差额计入。
items.summary_en: The guide explains exclusions for private use, UK origin, returned-goods relief and fully relieved temporary admission. Release into free circulation can trigger inclusion. Inward processing has distinct rules for CBAM and non-CBAM outputs; outward processing can use the value difference.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢材商业采购不因先入海关仓库就永久免CBAM。报价和供应链设计应核对最终用途、海关程序及释放时点，保留减免证据。
items.impact_en: Commercial steel is not permanently exempt merely because it enters warehousing. Check end use, customs discharge and supporting relief evidence.
items.coverage: 已核对官方正文；仅总结本页，不表示已阅读全文所链接的法规或附件。

items.title_original: Check which goods are in scope of Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
items.summary_en: The steel list covers 260112, chapter 72, 7301–7311, 7318 and 7326 for CO₂, excluding 7204 scrap and specified ferro-alloy codes. Confirm the complete commodity code and description.
items.impact_zh: 热轧、冷轧、镀层板及板坯客户应建立英国税号映射，不照搬欧盟清单；范围判断不等于确定税额或原产地结论。
items.impact_en: Map slab and flat-steel products to UK codes. Do not assume the EU list applies or infer tax amounts from scope alone.
items.coverage: 已核对官方钢铁行业完整清单；其他行业附件未读。

items.title_zh: 英国CBAM：2027年进口起留档，实际排放必须有核验证据
items.title_en: UK CBAM: records from 2027 and verified actual-emissions evidence
items.title_original: Keeping records for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
items.summary_zh: HMRC要求自2027年1月1日起保存货物8位税号、描述、税点日期、货值、净重和豁免证据；申报还需原产地及所属季度。记录一般保存至创建日或相关会计期末较晚者起6年。实际排放须有核验报告或摘要，否则用默认值；碳价抵扣须保留核验表、计算及GBP汇率。未留档可能罚£500。
items.summary_en: Records from January 2027 include codes, tax points, value, net mass and exemptions, with origin and quarter for returns. Generally retain for six years from the later relevant date. Actual emissions need verification; otherwise defaults apply. Relief needs verified calculations and GBP exchange rates. Missing records may attract £500.
items.impact_zh: 对钢厂与英国客户建立订单—炉批/生产装置—排放核验—进口单证的关联档案，提前明确数据提供责任。页面所说后续核验细则待发布，不能凭本页认定现有证书全部合格。
items.impact_en: Link orders and installations to verification and import records, and agree data responsibilities. The page alone does not establish that existing certificates meet forthcoming detailed requirements.
items.coverage: 已核对官方正文；仅总结本页，不表示已阅读全文所链接的法规或附件。

items.title_zh: 美国启动泰国耐腐蚀钢反规避调查，涉及中国原料加工后输美
items.title_original: Certain Corrosion-Resistant Steel Products From the People's Republic of China: Initiation of Circumvention Inquiry on the Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: A-570-026/C-570-027自2026年7月6日启动全国性反规避调查，范围为使用中国原产组件在泰国完成加工、再出口美国的耐腐蚀钢产品。商务部将审查加工程度、投资、价值、采购及贸易变化；初步和最终决定计划分别在立案后150天、300天内作出，可延期。本公告维持已被暂停清算货物的相应安排，并非对全部泰国货物作出规避终裁。
items.impact_zh: 中国原料供应商和泰国加工商应保存炉号、投入产出、加工成本、投资与销售链资料并及时应诉。需按货物与现有清算状态评估风险，不能仅凭立案推导统一税额。

items.summary_zh: 该倡议旨在解决铝行业二次原材料供应不足和价格高昂的问题。提案实施了委员会在2025年3月通过的钢铁和金属行动计划中承诺考虑对铝废料出口的贸易措施。

The proposal implements the Commission’s commitment to consider trade measures on exports of aluminium scrap as stated in the Steel and Metals Action Plan adopted in March 2025.
items.impact_zh: 对中国铝材出口商而言，欧盟可能实施的铝废料出口贸易措施将影响其在欧盟市场的竞争力，需关注后续政策动向。
items.impact_en: For Chinese aluminium exporters, the potential trade measures on aluminium scrap exports by the EU could affect their competitiveness in the EU market, necessitating close attention to subsequent policy developments.

items.title_original: WTO establishes CBAM dispute panel at Russia's request
items.summary_zh: WTO争端解决机构于2026年9月25日就俄罗斯诉欧盟案DS639成立专家组，审查欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）及俄罗斯所称欧盟排放交易体系下的出口补贴是否符合WTO义务。俄罗斯于2025年5月12日请求磋商、2026年7月10日请求设组；中国等成员保留第三方权利。专家组成立只是争端程序启动，尚无裁决。
items.summary_en: On 25 September 2026 the WTO DSB established a panel in DS639, Russia's challenge to the EU CBAM package and an alleged export subsidy under the EU ETS. Russia requested consultations on 12 May 2025 and a panel on 10 July 2026. China and other members reserved third-party rights. Panel establishment begins adjudication; no ruling has been issued.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：DS639不会自动暂停CBAM，欧盟现行申报、授权申报人和证书义务仍应照常准备。中国钢企可跟踪中国作为第三方提交的法律主张和后续报告，但当前不应据此延后碳数据、核证或客户合规安排。
items.impact_en: Assessment: DS639 does not automatically suspend CBAM. Existing EU reporting, authorised-declarant and certificate preparations should continue. Chinese steel exporters should monitor China's third-party submissions and later reports, but should not delay emissions-data, verification or customer-compliance work.
items.source_excerpt: WTO establishes CBAM dispute panel at Russia's request Kallanish
items.coverage: WTO DS639 case page and 25 September DSB news item checked; the collected media item is used only as the discovery record.

items.title_zh: 印度钢企转向本土市场，印度对中日俄热轧钢启动反倾销调查
items.title_original: Indian steelmakers pivot home as Europe tightens imports, China squeezes margins
items.summary_zh: 路透社报道，欧英收紧钢铁进口规则、低价中国钢材压缩利润，促使印度钢企更多转向国内市场。报道同时提到，印度已对来自中国、日本和俄罗斯的热轧钢进口启动反倾销调查。
items.impact_zh: 中国热轧出口印度面临新增贸易救济风险；在立案文件公布后，应优先核对调查期、涉案税号、产品排除和应诉节点。
items.summary_en: Reuters reports that tightening steel import rules in Europe and low-priced Chinese steel are prompting Indian steelmakers to turn more towards the domestic market. The report also mentions that India has initiated an antidumping investigation on hot-rolled steel imports from China, Japan, and Russia.
items.title_en: Indian Steelmakers Pivot Home as Europe Tightens Imports and China Squeezes Margins
items.impact_en: Chinese hot-rolled steel exports to India face new trade remedy risks; after the filing documents are published, priority should be given to verifying the investigation period, involved tax numbers, product exclusions, and response timelines.

items.title_zh: 欧盟给予嘉善Carrey紧固件39.6%新出口商反倾销税率
items.title_en: EU grants Carrey Intelligent Manufacturing the 39.6% new-exporter fastener duty rate
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2089 of 18 September 2026 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/191 imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of certain iron or steel fasteners originating in the People’s Republic of China following acceptance of a request for new exporting producer treatment
items.summary_zh: 欧盟实施条例(EU) 2026/2089确认Carrey Intelligent Manufacturing (Jiashan) Co., Ltd.满足新出口生产商待遇条件，并将其列入(EU) 2022/191附件，TARIC附加码88FN，适用未抽样合作企业39.6%的反倾销税率。该公司2022年成立、2023年获出口许可，并于2025年开始向欧盟出口涉案铁或钢制紧固件；条例自2026年9月22日起生效。

items.title_zh: 中国钢铁上半年产量下降，但6月日产水平显示韧性
items.title_original: China's steel sector looks weaker than it is, reverse for iron ore
items.summary_zh: 路透社分析称，中国2026年上半年钢产量同比下降约3%，地产需求仍弱；但6月粗钢产量为8,367万吨、日产水平升至三个月高位。铁矿石进口保持强劲，显示生产端并非单向走弱。
items.impact_zh: 国内需求偏弱仍会推动钢厂寻找出口，但短期生产韧性可能延续海外市场的供给与价格压力，并提高各国采取贸易措施的概率。
items.summary_en: According to Reuters, China's steel production in the first half of 2026 decreased by about 3% year-on-year, with weak demand from the real estate sector; however, crude steel production in June reached 83.67 million tons, with daily output rising to a three-month high. Iron ore imports remain strong, indicating that production is not solely weakening.
items.title_en: China's Steel Production Declines in H1, June Daily Output Shows Resilience
items.impact_en: Weak domestic demand will still drive steel mills to seek exports, but short-term production resilience may prolong supply and price pressures in overseas markets, increasing the likelihood of trade measures being taken by various countries.

items.title_zh: 中国钢材出口创纪录，但后续订单与贸易摩擦或压制涨势
items.title_original: China's steel exports hit record but rally may prove short-lived
items.summary_zh: 标普全球报道，中国钢材出口达到纪录水平，其中钢坯出口同比显著增长；但订单走弱以及2026年反倾销案件增加，可能使第三季度出口动能放缓。
items.impact_zh: 出口量越高，越容易触发进口国行业申诉和调查。钢厂应提前按市场、品种和客户监测订单下滑与立案风险，避免集中发运。
items.summary_en: S&P Global reports that China's steel exports have reached record levels, with significant year-on-year growth in semi-finished steel exports; however, weakening orders and an increase in anti-dumping cases in 2026 may slow export momentum in the third quarter.
items.title_en: China's Steel Exports Hit Record but Rally May Prove Short-Lived
items.impact_en: The higher the export volume, the more likely it is to trigger complaints and investigations from importing countries. Steel mills should monitor order declines and filing risks in advance based on market, variety, and customer to avoid concentrated shipments.

items.title_zh: 敬业集团就英国接管British Steel寻求补偿并考虑仲裁
items.title_original: Chinese company demands compensation from the UK over British Steel nationalization
items.summary_zh: 美联社报道，敬业集团因英国政府接管British Steel运营而要求补偿，并正依据双边投资安排磋商、考虑国际仲裁。英国方面表示将通过独立评估确定可能的补偿。
items.impact_zh: 事件不仅影响敬业集团资产处置，也会提高中资钢铁企业评估英国投资时对政府干预、关键产能认定及投资协定保护条款的关注。
items.summary_en: According to the Associated Press, Jingye Group is seeking compensation from the UK government for the takeover of British Steel operations and is negotiating based on bilateral investment arrangements, considering international arbitration. The UK side stated that it would determine possible compensation through an independent assessment.
items.title_en: Chinese Company Demands Compensation from the UK over British Steel Nationalization
items.impact_en: This event not only affects Jingye Group's asset disposal but also raises concerns among Chinese steel companies regarding government intervention, key capacity identification, and investment agreement protection clauses when evaluating investments in the UK.
